game.rules:
## Approved hardware/software (please specify in the run comment):

### NES Categories

- Original NES, Famicom or Famicom Disk System (FDS)
- Original NES or Famicom with EverDrive N8 (Pro), PowerPak, KrzysioCart or FDSStick
- Wii, Wii U, Switch and 3DS Virtual Console, GameBoy Advance
- Nestopia, BizHawk (NesHawk core only), OpenEmu (Nestopia core only), MesenRTA
- Frontends used in conjunction with these emulators that can alter the performance (ex. RetroArch) are not permitted
- If you use Mesen you must use the version linked on the resources page
- Input display and frame counter are required for emulators that have those features built in
- NES Classic Edition
- Analogue NT Mini
- RetroUSB AVS
- MiSTer

### SNES Categories

- Original SNES or Super Famicom
- Original SNES or Super Famicom with Super EverDrive or SD2SNES/FXPAK Pro
- Wii All-Stars Rerelease
- BizHawk (BSNES core only), MesenRTA-S, Mednafen (BSNES core only)
- Frontends used in conjunction with these emulators that can alter the performance (ex. RetroArch) are not permitted
- If you use Mesen-S you must use the version linked on the resources page
- Analogue Super Nt
- MiSTer

*If you do not see a specific platform on this list, then it is not permitted.*

## Global Rules

- Game audio must be present in the recording for the duration of the run.
- All times require a video on a publicly visible site.  YouTube and Twitch are fine.  Personal storage sites such as Google Drive and Dropbox are discouraged.  If the videos are removed or no longer accessible, the run is subject to removal from the leaderboard.
- Anything that you cannot do with an original and unmodified NES, brick controller and SMB1 cartridge is prohibited.  Including but not limited to:
- Turbo
- L + R
- Savestates
- Debugging tools (RAM watch, Lua scripts, ROM Debuggers)
- Altering the game speed (FPS)
- Using a bad ROM (missing title screen, different graphics, etc.)
- Pausing externally such as with Wii (U)/Switch Home Menu or pause hotkeys on emulators.
- You may be asked to provide us additional data upon request to assist us in our verification process.  Splits, input files (if applicable), entire attempt sessions and local recordings mostly cover what we'd ask for and it's a good idea to hang on to those.
- Custom color palettes with changes such as a red sky are discouraged unless they assist with any visual impairment. If you do use one, please submit the ".pal" file used. Do not make two different colours the same when creating a custom palette.
- Runs must begin in the first quest unless otherwise stated.
- For emulator submissions, holding L+R must be equal to holding nothing (neutral). Last input and other types of SOCD resolution are banned.

newsList.title: SNES9x Ban
newsList.body: Effective immediately, any submissions using the SNES9x emulator will not be verified. The SMB1 mod team has concerns about its integrity due to its ability to overclock and remove lag frames, which may not be easily detectable. Additionally, we request that all BizHawk submissions avoid using the S

categories.name: Glitchless (Archived)
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

Old leaderboard can be found here: http://www.twingalaxies.com/scores.php?scores=5717&ref=fbshare

## Goal
Beat the game as fast as possible without the use of the following glitches:
- Wall Jump  
- Wrong Warp  
- Flagpole Glitch  
- Bullet Bill Glitch  
- Wall Clip (Mario fully inside the wall)  

## Timing
Timing is done using the SDA standard:

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player. 

End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 8-4.

## Category Rules
- Times below 5:05.00 are treated with suspicion. It is highly recommended that you stream all of your attempts and provide split files to have your run accepted. 
- Times below 5:05.00 require an input file if you are playing on an emulator that can record input files.
- Using savestates to the title screen is prohibited. You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Beat the game as fast as possible by any means necessary.

## Timing

Timing is done using the SDA standard:

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 8-4.

## Category Rules

- Using save states to the title screen is prohibited. You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.
- Only runs faster than 5:03 (5:08 for PAL) are represented with milliseconds on the leaderboard. Please do not include milliseconds if your time is not below this threshold.
- It is recommended to hold onto full session, split files, input files, etc. in the event that a moderator requests additional evidence for verification.

Times below 4:57.000 are treated with additional scrutiny. The following is required for submissions below this threshold:

- The run's full session must be included in the submission's description. Additional attempt sessions may be requested at the discretion of the moderation team.
- For emulator submissions, the run must have an input display visible at all times. A hand-cam or input visualizer program is sufficient for emulators without a built-in input display.

From a new game, beat the game as fast as possible by any means necessary.

I'm still in absolute disbelief that this happened. After all the failed runs to 8-4 and constant slip ups in the later part of the game, I never thought that I could get such a time, but I finally was able to get its thanks to every single one of my amazing supporters! I am satisfied with this run, so until this is beaten, I will not be running any% anymore, and I will instead try other categories and games that I have been wanting to learn for quite some time.

*[Mod note: verified by Roopert and Tecate]*

16k attempts and 1.5 years, this is what it took to achieve this time. Beyond grateful for the friends and others I've met along the way, I seriously couldn't have done it without everyone's support. What seemed like a dream a few years ago has turned into reality and nothing else describes how relieved I am that I have finally done it. 4:55 in SMB1 any% took determination beyond anything I've ever done in my entire life. It goes to show that anything is possible if you put your mind to it, no matter what you've gone through. This game has given me ups and downs that have shaped the course of my future, and the lessons I've learned from everything means the world to me. It doesn't matter how weak you think you are, how bad you might think of yourself, or how useless you might think you are. What matters in the end is what you can make of yourself to achieve anything you dream of. Life has been rough for me mentally, and the struggles I've gone through made this goal even harder to achieve. However, to say that I've finally done it has given me the strength I need to push onward and live my life to the fullest. Never say that it can't happen or that you can't do it, because it can and you will. Seriously, thank you so much to everyone I've met in my speedrunning journey that was there for me when the road was hard to see, you mean the world to me. With that said, I love you all. Thank you so much.

P.S: Special shoutouts to Niftski, Brandon_Lepetrie, Nebula, Simplistic, KingOfJonnyBoy, Lain, LeKukie, Alabaster, Sawyer, Scrimsion, Miniland, and so so many more I'm certainly forgetting. If you interacted with me in SMB (or maybe SMO if you're OG) in any capacity, I am forever grateful for your encouragement and support throughout all these years. Here's to a brighter tomorrow :D

categories.rules:
*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

Beat the game as fast as possible by any means necessary.

## Timing

Timing is done using the SDA standard:

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 8-4.

## Category Rules

- Using save states to the title screen is prohibited. You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.
- Only runs faster than 5:03 (5:08 for PAL) are represented with milliseconds on the leaderboard. Please do not include milliseconds if your time is not below this threshold.
- It is recommended to hold onto full session, split files, input files, etc. in the event that a moderator requests additional evidence for verification.

Times below 4:57.000 are treated with additional scrutiny. The following is required for submissions below this threshold:

- The run's full session must be included in the submission's description. Additional attempt sessions may be requested at the discretion of the moderation team.
- For emulator submissions, the run must have an input display visible at all times. A hand-cam or input visualizer program is sufficient for emulators without a built-in input display.

*Please click on the "Game Rules" tab above to familiarize yourself with our rules for all categories.*

## Goal

From a new game, beat the game as fast as possible without using the warp zones.

## Timing

Timing is done using the SDA standard:

Start - The frame "400" appears in the top right corner after selecting 1 player.

End - The frame all sprites are invisible after touching the axe in 8-4.

## Category Rules

- Using save states to the title screen is prohibited. You must use the reset function on your emulator or console and the reset must be shown in the video.
- Only runs faster than 19:13 are represented with milliseconds on the leaderboard. Please do not include milliseconds if your time is not below this threshold.
- It is recommended to hold onto full session, split files, input files, etc. in the event that a moderator requests additional evidence for verification.

games.name: Super Mario Bros.
games.rules:
## Approved hardware/software (please specify in the run comment):

### NES Categories

- Original NES, Famicom or Famicom Disk System (FDS)
- Original NES or Famicom with EverDrive N8 (Pro), PowerPak, KrzysioCart or FDSStick
- Wii, Wii U, Switch and 3DS Virtual Console, GameBoy Advance
- Nestopia, BizHawk (NesHawk core only), OpenEmu (Nestopia core only), MesenRTA
- Frontends used in conjunction with these emulators that can alter the performance (ex. RetroArch) are not permitted
- If you use Mesen you must use the version linked on the resources page
- Input display and frame counter are required for emulators that have those features built in
- NES Classic Edition
- Analogue NT Mini
- RetroUSB AVS
- MiSTer

### SNES Categories

- Original SNES or Super Famicom
- Original SNES or Super Famicom with Super EverDrive or SD2SNES/FXPAK Pro
- Wii All-Stars Rerelease
- BizHawk (BSNES core only), MesenRTA-S, Mednafen (BSNES core only)
- Frontends used in conjunction with these emulators that can alter the performance (ex. RetroArch) are not permitted
- If you use Mesen-S you must use the version linked on the resources page
- Analogue Super Nt
- MiSTer

*If you do not see a specific platform on this list, then it is not permitted.*

## Global Rules

- Game audio must be present in the recording for the duration of the run.
- All times require a video on a publicly visible site.  YouTube and Twitch are fine.  Personal storage sites such as Google Drive and Dropbox are discouraged.  If the videos are removed or no longer accessible, the run is subject to removal from the leaderboard.
- Anything that you cannot do with an original and unmodified NES, brick controller and SMB1 cartridge is prohibited.  Including but not limited to:
- Turbo
- L + R
- Savestates
- Debugging tools (RAM watch, Lua scripts, ROM Debuggers)
- Altering the game speed (FPS)
- Using a bad ROM (missing title screen, different graphics, etc.)
- Pausing externally such as with Wii (U)/Switch Home Menu or pause hotkeys on emulators.
- You may be asked to provide us additional data upon request to assist us in our verification process.  Splits, input files (if applicable), entire attempt sessions and local recordings mostly cover what we'd ask for and it's a good idea to hang on to those.
- Custom color palettes with changes such as a red sky are discouraged unless they assist with any visual impairment. If you do use one, please submit the ".pal" file used. Do not make two different colours the same when creating a custom palette.
- Runs must begin in the first quest unless otherwise stated.
- For emulator submissions, holding L+R must be equal to holding nothing (neutral). Last input and other types of SOCD resolution are banned.
